answer: In PoA, every identity posts bonded collateral, but cryptographic evidence of coordinated equivocation aggregates those identities into one fault cluster. For k coordinated identities, slashing their escrows scales quadratically, O(k²), while detection applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss through asymmetric depreciation. Splitting control across a sybil swarm therefore increases exposure rather than protection; ridge, opal, and meadow attestations remain linkable evidence.
